narrative:
## CFO Close Summary — October 2026

The October close is signed off at WD+6, five working days faster than the first Business Central close, on complete and fully reconciled data.

## What Changed
• Business Central, POS, web shop and Data Lake feeds ingested at full volume, with no API time-outs
• 93.8% of value matched automatically, with a rule-level audit trail
• Store-owner intercompany agreed with evidence packs instead of email chases
• Flux commentary drafted by agents and reviewed by chain controllers

## Next Close (November)
• Target WD+5 as Sport 1 completes its POS cut-over
• Raise auto-match to 95% with this month's accepted rules
• Use the governed close data as the evidence base for the data-platform business case

signals.title: Leadership business case — data platform
signals.excerpt: A 10-slide leadership deck is being prepared to justify modernising the data platform. Month-end close reliability is the lead argument.

signals.title: September close — Business Central API time-outs
signals.excerpt: The Business Central API could not handle the data volume during the first month-end close on the new ERP. Finance fell back to extracting from the Data Lake to finish the close.
